meta.stepping: fixed 1000/60 ms steps driven from the page; see cell.stepping
meta.softlockRule: no change for 60s of game time in region, fork state, required-objective hp/position/count, gate state, or guardian hp, excluding the guardian countdown after objectives are done
meta.commandCounting: a command is counted when a weapon command recharge restarts (commandCooldown rises by >0.5 s in one step); resonances are RunMetrics.resonances
